comment.body:
The issue says U, H, J, and K stopped working after changing keybinds on PowerToys 0.86.0, even after turning Keyboard Manager off. Could you please:
1. Retest on the latest stable v0.102.3001 and share only the relevant mapping rows (source → target).
2. Remove those rows and disable Keyboard Manager, then confirm whether the four keys recover.
3. If any remain unusable, add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing and before restarting PowerToys.
This will distinguish an active mapping from a current failure to clear remap state.
